why: Lets pad actions through to the focus ring inside the controller self-test, whose whole subject is which physical control is which index (issue #599). A Confirm pressed there has to appear in the readout rather than activate whatever is focused, and a stick push has to move an axis bar rather than the focus. The sweep asserts this as a named SUPPRESSION rather than skipping the pane, so the one deliberate exception to 'every layer walks' is held to its stated behaviour instead of being a hole nobody can tell from a bug.
killedBy: every HUD layer is reachable by arrows and by a D-pad (issue #914) gives the pad the keyboard inside controller-selftest
